units: Test whether preserved correction/Theta generalizes across AI, evolution, science, organizations, and cognition.
How much self-transformation can occur before a system loses ability to discover that it transformed incorrectly?
Framework is described as conceptually specified while remaining questions are empirical.
Operationalize causal authority, separate external/internal channels, and find threshold predicting adaptive validity.
Possible continuous decline, phase transition, or no finite horizon.
External grounding, internal integration, and architectural constraints are candidate mechanisms.
Possible compatible growth, tradeoff, or threshold collapse.
Can Systems Be Designed to Increase Theta?
Potential strategies include uncertainty, diverse internal signals, consequence-rich environments, proxy isolation prevention, external veto.
Which internal states contain compressed adaptive information?
Hypothesis that unresolved signals may contain information and competing representations may be needed.
Measure residual agency, successor strength, and dependency/usefulness tradeoff.
Test instability from unrestricted reachability and relative growth of correction capacity.
Test preserved correction as general adaptive requirement across domains.
Empirical program (K_t,E_t)->Theta_t->n*; primary unknown is recursive change before wrong-direction detection is lost.
GRA and Ancestor Intelligence are described as different layers; source states GRA subset Ancestor Intelligence, with GRA as constraint and Ancestor Intelligence as full system.
GRA asks how self-modifying system remains reality-connected; central object Theta protects correction pathway.
Ancestor Intelligence asks how systems create future systems exceeding themselves while preserving adaptive continuity; includes knowledge, capability, agency transfer, successors, alignment.
Source diagram places Grounded Recursive Adaptation beneath Ancestor Intelligence as grounding mechanism preventing uncontrolled optimization.
M_q*V_u*P_M, representing reality modeling, uncertainty, and model improvement.

R_task + alpha DeltaA_human + gamma DeltaA_future - beta Dependency.

Replacement increases machine centrality/human dependency; ancestor pattern increases capable humans/successors and reduces dependency.
Remove system and measure DeltaA_remaining; collapse indicates substitution, stronger remaining capability indicates descendants.

GRA=preservation mechanism; Ancestor Intelligence=generative architecture; together recursive capability under GRA.
Cross-field comparison of GRA as preserved correction under recursive transformation.
Reward optimization contrasted with whether consequences can modify reward-interpretation mechanism.
Feedback must remain able to update a changing controller.
Extends state feedback into recursive transformation-mechanism feedback.
Evolution interpreted as preserving viable-solution generation because environmental consequences retain authority.
Shifts from correct-objective specification to preserving discovery of objective failure.
Understanding is connected to preserving causal access; hidden causally powerful processes risk causal>represented influence.
Suppression is predicted to create hidden causal influence; integration S_raw->S_represented->S_controlled is compared to Jungian individuation.
Healthy organizations preserve external reality->internal correction->strategy; internal metrics can displace external consequences.
Information matters insofar as it changes reachable futures through R->Omega->C->A->R'.
GRA proposes shared constraint that recursive improvement remains adaptive only while correction authority is preserved; optimization may continue after adaptation ends.
Classifies systems by capability growth, correction capacity, environmental authority, and recursive self-transformation.
K_(t+1)=F(K_t) rather than meaningful environmental update; Theta->0 while capability may remain high; labeled capability drift risk.
X_(t+1)=F(X_t,E_t), C>0 but Gamma approximately 0; responsive without improving adaptation process.
R_(t+1)=G(R_t,E_t), Lambda>0; learns representations but correction may still decline.
G_(t+1)=H(G_t,E_t), Gamma>0; can improve learning, creating risk that learning improves faster than corrigibility.
H_(t+1)=K(H_t,E_t) subject to Theta>0; self-modification with correction preservation.
Capability derivative positive and dTheta/dn<0; increasing efficiency with collapsing adaptation.
Preserves Theta_ext and Theta_int, combined as product; reality and internal signals remain causally represented.
Residual future agency>0 with dependency->0; creates successors and transfers agency.
Summary table assigns qualitative Theta/capability/adaptation statuses to Closed, Reactive, Learning, Meta-Learning, Drift, GRA, and Deletion-Generative systems.
Advanced adaptation is defined by remaining changeable by consequences while changing.
Open-ended intelligence/adaptation is not improvement alone; recursive improvement requires preserved corrigibility.
Capability growth through representation/optimization/search/compression/self-modification is not equivalent to adaptive growth.
E_n->K_(n+1)->E_(n+1); if broken into internally closed K_(n+1)=K(K_n), system is a closed optimizer.
Theta_n(K_n,E_n)>0 as validity condition; system remains adaptive domain while Theta>epsilon.
C,Lambda,Gamma can increase while Theta decreases; capability drift.
Theta->0: reality loses authority despite possible improvement.
n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}, maximum recursive depth before leaving adaptive domain.
Theta_ext:E_world->K_(n+1), Theta_int:S_i->K_(n+1); mature system requires both.
Open-ended adaptation is recursive self-transformation under preserved causal pathways from consequence to correction.
